subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should WhatsApp terminate an inbound media download after 30 seconds without a chunk, or should this fixed cutoff be retuned before merge?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the guard works, but repository evidence cannot determine the acceptable false-timeout threshold for real WhatsApp media transfers.

options.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
options.body: Land the current plugin-local default because it matches established channel idle-timeout precedent and avoids adding another configuration surface.

options.title: Retune the fixed cutoff
options.body: Select a longer WhatsApp-specific idle budget and refresh the timeout and progressing-stream proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
recommendation.body: Land the current plugin-local default because it matches established channel idle-timeout precedent and avoids adding another configuration surface.
